test_is_multi_run: test the _is_multi_run function to detect whether a directory contains multiple run configurations
test_refresh_fingerprint: test the _refresh_fingerprint function to verify it changes when relevant trace artifacts are modified
test_is_multi_run_split_root: test that _is_multi_run treats a split root with only scenario results as a single run
test_is_multi_run_nested_experiment: test that _is_multi_run detects nested experiment directories containing run_config.json files
test_refresh_fingerprint_unrelated_files: test that _refresh_fingerprint ignores unrelated files like notes.txt when computing the fingerprint
